title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in iova.mihai…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in SliceWP versions up to 1.2.13 due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This vulnerability allows an attacker to inject malicious scripts that can execute in the context of other users. The flaw affects confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.
